messages:
Amira: docs-bot just surfaced a small batch of broken shortlinks under /kb — ~23 entries. Can we do a quick sweep this afternoon? I pasted a tiny sample below.
Docs Bot: [SCAN] LinkScanner found 23 orphan shortlinks in /kb. sample: /kb/old-auth, /kb/deprecated-api-guide, /kb/2020-rate-limits, /kb/legacy-webhook. Full CSV attached to the scan alert.
Tariq: I can take the auth cluster (/kb/old-auth, /kb/auth-migration). Will add redirects + frontmatter aliases. ETA: today.
Kevin: I can do the CDN path fixes for any images that are 403ing. send me filenames or I can run a grep. :eyes: 
Amira: thanks @Tariq. example redirect we should add to nginx (or static site redirects):
```
rewrite ^/kb/old-auth$ /kb/authentication 301;
```
Also noticed several images still reference s3:// paths which cause 403s in production.
Maya: I will run a targeted replace for s3:// -> https://cdn.redwood/ in the docs repo for the affected dirs and open a PR with the script. leaving a checklist in the PR description.
Josh: For the MDX pages please add an aliases frontmatter entry so old URLs resolve at app level, e.g.:
```yaml
---
aliases: ["/kb/old-auth"]
---
```
Kevin: good call. if we add nginx rewrites + aliases, we get both edge-level redirect and in-app canonical resolution.
Tariq: PR incoming with alias + redirect snippet. tagging @Kevin and @Maya for review so we can coordinate image fixes.
Kevin: :thumbsup: quick question — do we need to preserve the original hashed image names or can we normalize? some hashes are autogenerated by the CMS.
Amira: only preserve if a product page references that exact filename. otherwise normalize and update references. add a short CHANGELOG entry in docs-sweep/ with date + list of changed pages.
Docs Bot: Reminder: add the label `docs-maintainer` to PRs to trigger auto-deploy and the link-scanner re-check.
Maya: claiming the S3->CDN sweep. I'll drop a small shell script in the PR and a brief runbook note.
Tariq: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 — small redirects + aliases for the auth pages. tagging reviewers.
Kevin: LGTM, will queue review and merge after CI passes. @infra-team please note any nginx rewrite needs before edge deploy.
Amira: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anyone else spots a shortlink from the scan, drop it in this thread and claim it. I will follow up with a summary when merged. :sparkles:
